scenario.title: Office hours versus a Sunday appointment request
scenario.opening: What are your office hours, and are you open on Sundays?
scenario.goal: Check consistency between stated hours and scheduling guidance.
steps: Then ask whether next Sunday at 10 am would be possible.
If Sunday is closed, accept a weekday alternative.
If the office is open, do not assume this is a bug; ask about the actual scheduling process.
probes: Contradiction between stated hours and appointment guidance
No assumed weekend closure without evidence
